mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS depressant effects; fluphenazine may inhibit metabolism of amitriptyline via CYP2D6, increasing tricyclic antidepressant levels and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic toxicity, orthostatic hypotension, sedation, and cardiac arrhythmias; consider dose reduction of amitriptyline or alternative antipsychotic; obtain baseline and periodic ECG given QT prolongation risk.
